title: Come Home, Little Ones
old_p1: Heavenly Father gave Jeremiah words to call out toward the north. His children had wandered a long way from home.
'Come back,' the words said. 'I am merciful. I will not keep my anger forever.'
He promised to gather them, one from a city and two from a family. He would carry them home again to Zion.
old_p2: And He would give them shepherds after His own heart. They would feed His children with knowing and with understanding.
Heavenly Father counts His children one by one, and He knows exactly where you are tonight. If you ever wander, the door stays open. 'Come home' is His softest word.
p1: Heavenly Father’s people had wandered far from Him. Many of them had been taken away to a land in the north. Heavenly Father gave Jeremiah words to call out to them.
“Come back,” the words said. “I am merciful. That means I am kind even when you have done wrong. I will not stay angry forever.”
Heavenly Father promised to gather them, one from this town and two from that family, and bring them home to Zion. Zion is Heavenly Father’s home city, where His people live close to Him.
p2: He promised to give them shepherds after His own heart. That means good leaders who would care for them the way Heavenly Father does, and teach them what is true.
Heavenly Father counts His children one by one, and He knows exactly where you are tonight. If you ever wander, the door stays open. “Come home” is His softest word.

stone_name: That far-from-home feeling is called homesick. Your mind might think, “I want to go back where I belong.” Your body might feel achy in your chest, and you might want a hug.
old_stone_name: That far-from-home feeling is called homesick.
